summary: Iter 24 — Full backend + frontend testing of the new Product Catalog + Quotation workflow (quotations_v2). Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter24_quotations_v2.py covering Products CRUD (list/get/create/patch/delete + search & category filters + 422 when product used in a quotation), Quotations (multi-line total = sum(qty*price), zero-lines 422, invalid vendor 422, invalid product 422, list+get+print HTML containing vendor/project/lines/total), Send (whatsapp returns wa.me link built from vendor.phone and logs QuotationShareLog; email attempted via SMTP and logs even when SMTP fails — expected; vendor with no phone → 422; editing vendor phone and re-sending uses the new number while old log rows are untouched), Vendor Payments (SiteEngineer 403; Accountant creates outgoing Payment; project balance-sheet released.total and released.vendor_payments both increase by paid amount; a 'Vendor payment — …' debit entry appears in entries; client_paid credit is NOT inflated; org /api/finance/balance-sheet exposes vendor_payments in per-project breakdown; project /finance/summary exposes vendor_payments key). Frontend (Playwright, admin login kesari4416): /admin/procurement/vendors shows add-vendor-button, vendors-table without per-row Add Product, and a distinct Products Global Catalog section with add-product-button, product-form-modal, products-table with product-edit-{id}/product-delete-{id} — created & edited TEST_UIProd_1787076691 (price 250→275). /admin/projects/1/procurement → quotations-section → make-quotation-button opens make-quotation-modal (distinct from vendor-form-modal); mq-vendor-select had 6 options, mq-product-select-0 had 8; selecting the edited TEST_ product PRE-FILLED mq-price-0 = 275 (matches default_price after edit) and stayed editable; qty=3 updated mq-total live to ₹825; mq-add-row + mq-remove-row-1 work; mq-submit created QTN-2026-0009 and navigated to /admin/projects/1/procurement/quotations/9. Quotation detail: quotation-number QTN-2026-0009, vendor Apex Steel Works, total ₹825; quotation-send-whatsapp → send-confirm-dialog showed send-contact-value '+911234567890' → send-confirm produced 1 share-log-row with 'Whatsapp' + SENT; quotation-send-email showed vendor email vikram@apexsteel.com in send-contact-value; quotation-status-select PATCH to 'accepted' (badge now ACCEPTED); quotation-record-payment opened vendor-payment-modal with vp-amount-input PRE-FILLED to 825 (total); vp-submit succeeded and toast rendered 'Payment recorded — reflected in the project balance sheet'. No compile errors, no blank pages, no runtime error overlays.
critical_code_review_comments: quotations_v2.py send_quotation swallows the SMTP failure with a bare 'except Exception: status = failed' and never records the reason on QuotationShareLog. Consider persisting an error_detail column (or JSON) so the UI can surface WHY the email failed (mirrors what we added to estimate send-approval in iter23). Right now the frontend share-log row can only say 'FAILED' with no reason.

quotations_v2.py quotation_number generation uses db.query(Quotation).count()+1 for the sequence — this is racy under concurrent creates on the same year and can produce duplicate quotation numbers. Should use a per-year sequence with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE or a dedicated sequence/counter row.

quotations_v2.py:150 seq counts across ALL projects and years — the yyyy prefix hides that on year rollover the counter continues (e.g. QTN-2027-0100 instead of QTN-2027-0001). Reset per year: db.query(Quotation).filter(extract('year', Quotation.created_at)==date.today().year).count()+1.

quotations_v2.py delete_line_item uses q.line_items.remove(li) but does not db.delete(li); depending on cascade config this can leave orphan QuotationLineItem rows. Prefer db.delete(li) + recompute + commit.
quotations_v2.py:289 SMTP timeout is hard-coded to 20s inside a request thread — a stuck SMTP host will block the FastAPI worker; consider offloading to a background task or shorter connect timeout.

MakeQuotationModal — when a product is selected and default_price is null/0, the field is left blank; consider auto-focusing mq-price-{i} so the user knows they must enter it manually (currently users can accidentally submit unit_price=0 which the API happily accepts since ge=0).

QuotationDetailPage — record-payment modal accepts an amount but does not validate against the outstanding balance (already-paid vs total). Not a bug per spec, but a nice guard to prevent over-paying a vendor for a single quotation.
